articles.title: Eagles Hunted Baboons Much Heavier Than Themselves
articles.summary: Verreaux's eagles in Chad hunted adult baboons weighing up to 58 pounds, making scientists rethink whether eagles once threatened our small early human relatives.

articles.title: Voyager 1 Reaches a Light-Day From Earth
articles.summary: Voyager 1 reaches a light-day from Earth on November 18, while Voyager 2 will not get there until about 2035, because the twins took different paths.

articles.title: A New Material Uses Water to Help Capture Carbon
articles.summary: Oregon State researchers created BVR-X, a sponge-like material that keeps water and carbon dioxide apart so it can keep capturing carbon in humid factory exhaust.
